extracted.name: Southern Sausage Gravy
ingredient_lines: 1 pound Jimmy Dean® Country Mild™ sausage
instruction_lines: Cook sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned. Without draining sausage, add flour and combine.
Gradually add milk and stir constantly. Heat gravy until bubbling and thickened, remove from heat. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve with buttermilk biscuits and enjoy!
